description: Definition of the AWS::QuickSight::ApprovalPolicy Resource Type.

ApplicableTo.description:
Scoping: who the policy applies to.
GROUP: `groupArns` required (one or more group ARNs).

GroupArns.description: Required when type = GROUP. One or more group ARNs.

AssetType.description:
Asset types that can be governed by approval policies.
Must stay in sync with cedar-schema.json entityTypes:
https://code.amazon.com/packages/AmazonQuickApprovalWFService/blobs/mainline/--/src/main/resources/cedar-schema.json

GovernedAction.description:
Actions that can be governed by approval policies.
This enum controls SDK-exposed actions. The Cedar schema may define additional
internal actions (e.g. PUBLISH) not yet exposed to customers.
See: https://code.amazon.com/packages/AmazonQuickApprovalWFService/blobs/mainline/--/src/main/resources/cedar-schema.json

Actions.description: List of governed actions a policy applies to.

ApprovalGroups.description:
List of approval group ARNs (e.g. QuickSight group ARNs).
At least one approval group is required; the upper bound is enforced
per-account at the service layer via the configurable approver-group limit.

AssetTypes.description:
List of asset types a policy applies to.
At least one asset type is required.
